hook: Light your empty slots as fake targets, watch enemies swing at nothing, then snuff a fat Hoard into a carry.
loop: Each turn, choose unit or Light for every empty slot.
Front Lights soak swings; back Lights bank Bury into Hoards.
Snuff a Hoard into a carry, or let capstones cash Lights in.

growth.line: Hoards grow under Lights each turn, bigger at Tier 5; snuffing cashes them in; strikes add fight buffs.

feel.early: Spare slots make Lights free; Phos and Foxfire win fights.
feel.mid: Joan and Sexton bank Hoards; pick defence or savings.
feel.late: Slots get scarce; three capstones cash the Lights in.

stars.why: Enemies that strike a Light hit their own side for full Attack.
Hoards rise as fighters every fight, and the bank stays intact.
Hops from Hoard to Hoard, leaving a fresh Light behind.

card_short.u01: Played: Light an empty slot. Sold: Light its own slot.
card_short.u02: Grows permanently whenever your Lights are struck, twice a fight.
card_short.u03: First attack each fight lands on its nearest Light instead.
card_short.u04: Played: buff a unit, or Bury under every Light.
card_short.u05: Gold each turn for your Lights left unstruck last fight.
card_short.u06: End of Turn: Light your first empty slot.
card_short.u07: When it snuffs a Light, relights the slot it left.
card_short.u08: Each struck Light gets stats Buried under it.
card_short.u09: Deals 3 damage to each enemy that strikes your Lights.
card_short.u10: Snuffs also give half the Hoard to the snuffer's neighbours.
card_short.u11: End of Turn: biggest other unit grows per Light you have.
card_short.u12: Start of Combat: Light every empty front-row slot this fight.
card_short.u13: Gain gold whenever you snuff a Light, twice a turn.
card_short.u14: End of Turn: Bury under every Light, double if unstruck.
card_short.u15: Each struck Light gives your units stats for the fight.
card_short.u16: Relights struck Lights once; random enemy effects hit Lights instead.
card_short.u17: Enemies striking Lights hit their own side for their Attack.
card_short.u18: Start of Combat: Hoards rise as Risen Wisps, Hoard kept.
card_short.u19: Start of Combat: all units get +3/+3 per lit Light.
card_short.x01: 1/1 that fights with a Hoard's stats added.

builds.name: Lantern Fortress
builds.line: Units hide behind front Lights; strikes deal damage and buff the team.

builds.name: Hoard Mere
builds.line: Bank Hoards under safe back Lights, then snuff or raise them.

builds.name: Few and Bright
builds.line: Three big units, four Lights; Old Will and Irrlicht multiply.

liked: All three: unit or Light on every slot is a real choice each turn.
Empty slots become the resource; no other tribe plays on its gaps.
worries: Watch Tiddy Mun: doubled strikes stack with Barn Owl, and with Ignis Fatuus self-hits.
Lamplighter's early Bury runs double target; Map-Seller's unstruck rule is unclear.
changed: Hobby Lantern's swap now lasts the fight and keeps the Light's Hoard.
Aarnivalkea resolves last at Start of Combat; Risen Wisps cover their Light.
Random enemy effects pick only units, so Tiddy Mun's redirect now matters.
verdict: Positioning fans play on their own gaps, lighting fake targets and saving a big Hoard reveal.
